defects.description: The heading "Escalation Protocol" should use the required Russian term for "Escalation" (Эскалация) and be translated.
The heading "Escalation Reasons" should be translated using the required term (Причина эскалации) and not left in English.
The heading "Escalation Document" should be translated and include the required term "Эскалация".
The heading "Escalation Resolution Paths" should be translated and contain the required term "Эскалация".
